verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a full Terminal API and Management API for POS payments, refunds, tipping, terminal management, plus an official OpenAPI spec repo on GitHub and even an MCP server for natural-language access — all strongly supporting programmatic/API-driven control suitable for AI-native use. Missing for 10: a working openapi.json/swagger endpoint directly on docs.adyen.com (probe shows 404s, spec lives only in GitHub repo) and broader independent corroboration beyond one dated HN complaint about integration friction.
